purpose: Recovery archive for replacing issues that created cross-reference backlinks upstream. Do not copy unredirected external links into new issues.

issues.title: Build a reproducible integration baseline from PR 54
issues.body:
## Goal

Establish a **reproducible, pinned integration baseline** in this fork for combining independent integer-multiplication improvements, then use it as the foundation for new search experiments.

This issue is about research infrastructure and reproduction, **not** claiming a new exponent or merging unreviewed results into `main`.

## Reference policy: no unsolicited upstream backlinks

For external GitHub PRs, issues, or commits referenced in Issues, PR descriptions, comments, and commit messages, use `https://redirect.github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/NUMBER` (or the corresponding `/issues/NUMBER` or `/commit/SHA` path), not direct `github.com` issue/PR links or `OWNER/REPO#NUMBER` references. This preserves clickable sources without adding GitHub cross-reference backlinks to contributors' discussions. Write PR numbers as plain text such as `PR 54`; pin immutable source commits separately. Do not mention upstream contributors with `@username` unless explicitly intended.

## Starting point

- Upstream: https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds
- Current candidate: https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/54
- Pin PR 54 head: `chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds@7210de7d0f9ccaeb64c3f60f188419e02be08d95`
- PR 54 builds on PR 53 (`ikeboy/integer-mult-bounds@3ffd4021995c959ac02d12920e0279ae97dd03c7`), combining skip-prefix strips with paid whole-chain clones inspired by PR 51.
- Reported *conditional* baseline: `κ = 141532521 / 3125000000000 = 4.529040672e-5`, `W = 159592676`. These are research claims, not a proof of the inherited all-size assumptions.

PR 54 was a draft with focused checks passing and full repository `make verify` pending when this issue was scoped. Confirm its status again before implementation.

## Tasks

- [ ] Keep this fork's `main` clean; create a dedicated experimental branch/worktree from a **pinned** PR 54 commit.
- [ ] Reproduce `make skip-clones-verify` using the documented build prerequisites; capture exit status, command, runtime, and relevant hashes.
- [ ] Run the broader `make verify` where feasible; capture a complete receipt or an explicit, reproducible resource/time blocker.
- [ ] Add a manually triggered GitHub Actions workflow (`workflow_dispatch`) with bounded timeout and read-only permissions to repeat the baseline checks.
- [ ] Upload logs, machine-readable verification receipts, and source commit hashes as Actions artifacts; avoid relying on ephemeral runner state.
- [ ] Document the boundaries between **producer/order layout** (PR 52 / PR 53), **paid clone transformations** (PR 51 / PR 54), **carrier matching**, **frames/bases**, and **exact κ certification**.
- [ ] Record which combinations are already implemented, which are potentially compatible, and which require new proof obligations (notably PR 51's enlarged signed frames versus PR 54's original envelopes).
- [ ] Open separate, linked follow-up Issues for search algorithms and individual cross-branch integrations rather than extending this baseline issue indefinitely.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A contributor can rerun the **same pinned candidate** locally or through Actions and retrieve an auditable result.
2. The resulting baseline records `R23`, `R25`, `W`, the exact rational `κ`, checks run, and their pass/fail status.
3. An integration map identifies the relevant source files, upstream PRs, and mathematical/verification interfaces without silently assuming independent improvements can be added.
4. No unverified upstream changes or generated artifacts are silently incorporated into the fork's `main`.

## Research hygiene

Preserve source attribution, licenses, and substantial AI-assistance disclosures. Keep finite certificates separate from claims about inherited analytic and fixed-tape interfaces. Treat future upstream PRs as separately pinned candidates, not moving targets.

## Research landscape reference: Beyond n log n

- Dashboard: https://beyond-n-log-n.netlify.app/
- Open-source implementation and methodology: https://redirect.github.com/Paureel/beyond-n-log-n
- Use **Timeline**, **Lineage**, **Contributions**, **Field map**, and **Forks** to discover independently developed techniques, explicit cross-PR reuse, and upstream/fork-local research that could inform integration candidates.
- The dashboard updates GitHub-derived research claims, but its extracted κ values are **reported conditional claims**, not independent theorem verification. Its lineage links indicate described reuse/dependency, **not proof that methods compose**; verify candidate compatibility against pinned source and mathematical interfaces.
- When documenting the integration map, include relevant dashboard links **alongside primary PRs and immutable commit SHAs**. Preserve a reproducible source ledger rather than depending on a mutable dashboard snapshot.

issues.title: [Follow-up] Search paid clone schedules on the pinned PR 53 graph
issues.body:
Follow-up to [fork issue 1](https://redirect.github.com/tara-sooo/integer-mult-bounds/issues/1). The baseline pins PR 54 at `chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds@7210de7d0f9ccaeb64c3f60f188419e02be08d95` and the PR 53 producer at `3ffd4021995c959ac02d12920e0279ae97dd03c7`.

## Goal

Search for improved paid whole-chain clone schedules on the pinned PR 53 graph without changing its producer/order layout or envelope family.

## Required invariants

- Every clone uses two distinct unused provider capacities that precede the first moved use.
- Provider operands form the exact disjoint source partition of the parent.
- The entire continuation chain moves, with no redirected provider input or chronology violation.
- Each clone preserves the parent's original core/cover envelope.
- Regenerate the actual matching, fixed-basis profiles, complete physical word, both dirty-state orientations, and exact assembly certificate for any selected candidate.

## Acceptance

Record the search method, deterministic inputs/seeds, source hashes, candidate schedules, and exact replay receipts. Compare R23, R25, W, and rational kappa against the pinned baseline. Search scores and an alleged optimal matching are not proof inputs; no improvement is claimed until the full witness replay passes.

Primary sources: [PR 54](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/54), [PR 53](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/53), [PR 44 profiler](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/44).

issues.title: [Follow-up] Integrate PR 52 producer layout with PR 54 paid clones
issues.body:
Follow-up to [fork issue 1](https://redirect.github.com/tara-sooo/integer-mult-bounds/issues/1). Compare the longer-climb/reordered producer from PR 52, pinned for this task at `rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds@5b58921c9757ffc48663ae010322c0f2a679b2ce`, with the paid clones in PR 54's pinned snapshot `chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds@7210de7d0f9ccaeb64c3f60f188419e02be08d95`.

## Goal

Determine whether a PR 52 producer/order layout can support new PR 54 clone jobs. Existing PR 54 jobs are tied to the PR 53 graph hashes and chronology; they cannot be copied across layouts by assumption.

## Required work

- State which producer/order rules differ between the pinned PR 52 and PR 53 sources.
- Rebuild the candidate graph and discover/replay new clone jobs against that exact graph.
- Check source partitions, provider chronology/capacity, original core/cover envelopes, carrier matching, fixed I+J profiles, and both complete dirty-state orientations.
- Regenerate the exact role counts, W, kappa, and all assembly margins from the resulting graph.

## Acceptance

Provide immutable source pins, reproducible generated inputs, complete finite replay and an explicit proof-obligation list. If an interface does not compose, record the failing check and leave the candidate unintegrated. Do not infer composability from the dashboard lineage.

Primary sources: [PR 52](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/52), [PR 53](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/53), [PR 54](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/54), [research dashboard](https://beyond-n-log-n.netlify.app/).

issues.title: [Follow-up] Check PR 51 enlarged frames with PR 54 paid clones
issues.body:
Follow-up to [fork issue 1](https://redirect.github.com/tara-sooo/integer-mult-bounds/issues/1). PR 51 is pinned here at `hipotures/integer-mult-bounds@ee552125fb82c1664740fcc6c5eb97cad74d6bbd`; PR 54's reviewed baseline is pinned at `chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds@7210de7d0f9ccaeb64c3f60f188419e02be08d95`.

## Goal

Assess whether PR 51's enlarged signed positive frames can be composed with PR 54's paid clones on the PR 53 skip-prefix graph.

The PR 54 proof explicitly specializes paid clones to the original core/cover envelopes and does not use PR 51's enlarged frames. Treating PR 51's broader frame family as interchangeable would leave a proof gap.

## Required work

- Give a frame-containment argument for every moved source and consumer in both physical orientations, or identify a smaller valid frame family.
- Recheck provider chronology, source partitions, carrier uses, frame/basis compatibility, and the full dirty-state word.
- Recompute actual fixed profiles, rank accounting, W and every exact assembly inequality after any valid frame change.

## Acceptance

Deliver an immutable candidate pin, a written general compatibility argument, fresh finite producers/profile receipts, and an exact kappa certificate. If the wider frames cannot be shown to compose, document the obstruction and retain the PR 54 original-envelope baseline unchanged.

Primary sources: [PR 51](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/51), [PR 54](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/54), [PR 53](https://redirect.github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/53), [research dashboard](https://beyond-n-log-n.netlify.app/).
